events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: Your cancellation fee of $6.61 stands. You cancelled the ride yourself about 7 minutes after you were matched with a driver, and our rules make the fee chargeable once more than 3 minutes have passed since matching. There is no free cancellation simply because the driver had not yet reached you. Your driver had already arrived nearby and waited. The $6.61 will be charged as a Ryde voucher, not cash. If paying this would cause you hardship, you can ask for a waiver through RydeHELP within 30 days. Nothing else changes on your account.

DRIVER: No action against you, and no fee is charged to you. The rider cancelled this RydeX trip herself, about 7 minutes after matching, so the $6.61 cancellation fee goes to her and is paid as a Ryde voucher, not cash. Your part checked out: you tapped "I'm Here" at the pickup area and stayed close by, stationary, until the cancellation came through. No no-show or route issue is upheld against you, so this will not affect your account and no flag is being added, including from any earlier dispute.
